newsitem.title: GERMANY: Prodi says Italy CPI can fall more near term.
newsitem.headline: Prodi says Italy CPI can fall more near term.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi said Italian inflation could fall further in the near term but much depended on international factors.
Prodi, speaking at a news conference on a visit to Germany, said: "In the near term inflation can fall again a little, at least as far as concerns domestic factors which we are able to control."
"Much depends also on international factors like the prices of raw materials," he said.
Preliminary consumer prices data due on Thursday and Friday are forecast to show inflation at 2.5 percent year on year in February from 2.6 percent in January.
